load.definition: Garmin training load: EPOC, from heart rate. It barely registers lifting — read strength by tonnage and sets, never with cardio in one number.

tonnage.definition: Σ weight × reps over every logged set, warm-ups included — they were lifted.

fuel_taken.definition: What you logged taking, in grams, from each product's label and your bottle recipe as it was that day. Self-reported: Garmin does not record it.

score.definition: How the session went against what was planned for it that day, 0–100. Execution, not fitness: heat, decoupling and efficiency stay flags. Each part scores 0–1 and earns its weight; a part that cannot be scored drops out and the others rescale. Under 60 % of the session scored, no total. 85+ As planned · 70–84 Mostly · 50–69 Partly · under 50 Off plan · under 60 % scored: Unclear. A gym session with a planned exercise not started scores 84 at most.
